what: 003's tray with a rectangular corner relief 4 mm across at each corner, centred where the bends' zones' centre lines cross
method: T = 2, R = 1, K = 0.5, the corner gap g = 0.5. A bend zone is BA = theta (R + K T) wide in the flat; folded it is an annular sector holding theta T (R + T/2) a mm of bend, T BA with K = 0.5, and every panel moves rigidly, so V = T x the flat area. The notch leaves 003's flat: at each corner the base lies past both bends' tangent lines, s0 = (R + T) tan 45 = 3 in from the edges; each zone, BA = pi wide outside its tangent line (from 3 - pi to 3 in), ends square where the other's tangent line crosses it; each panel lies past its zone, its end e = T + g/sqrt2 = 2.353553 from the other edge (003: the panel ends T + g/sqrt2 short of the other's outer face line), and 003's V is 22251.656329. A corner relief belongs to the corner's two bends and is cut from every piece of the flat it reaches (the bends keep their notched ends): it is centred where the two zones' centre lines cross, c = s0 - BA/2 = 3 - pi/2 = 1.429204 in from both edges, 4 mm across (r = 2). In coordinates X, Y from that centre along the two bends, with d = s0 - c = pi/2: the base is X, Y >= d; one zone is X >= d, -d <= Y <= d (the other the same across the diagonal); one panel is Y <= -d, X >= X0 = e - c = 0.924350. A square of side 4 along the bends, |X|, |Y| <= r = 2, takes of the base and the two zones (X >= d or Y >= d) 2 (r^2 - d^2) - (r - d)^2 = 2.880983, and of each panel (r - X0)(r - d) = 0.461673: each corner takes 3.804328 of the flat. V = 22251.656329 - 4 x 2 x 3.804328 = 22221.221704. (The flat-first relief, an r x r square cut from the base at the corner of the bends with both bends starting r from it, made it 22119.125364.)
